name: Generate complete factory worker briefs with one command
description:
Factory review recommendation 7 of 20.

## Context

The supervisor assembles briefs through several calls and a hand-filled template, which has already drifted across workers.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a command that assembles Story, Specs, Tasks, Comments, Epic, links, Stage Prompt, ROWBLY.md and Stage context.
- Produce a deterministic brief suitable for worker launch and include retry context when applicable.
- Update the factory skill to consume the generated brief.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor plan review: Do not implement the proposed ADR/API changes yet. I asked the user to approve a narrow exception permitting ROWBLY.md to be read as inert text; AGENTS.md requires user approval to reverse accepted ADR guidance. While waiting, refine the smallest read-only context design and inventory existing pipeline fixtures; no user-dependent changes. Reserve ADR-0044 provisionally (ROW-59 has proposed 0043), recheck before publishing. Do NOT delete references/worker-brief.md: ROW-63 and ROW-66 are completing changes to it. Generated briefs must preserve their retry and assigned-worker rules; merge their landed changes before replacing skill steps, and retain template as human fallback unless separately agreed. --retry-file passing captured context is acceptable in principle; coordinate with ROW-63's actual text. A new cross-Plugin contribution hook and failing-contributor behavior touches Plugin loading/pipeline: extend an existing fixture test for failure isolation and preserved Plugin Data; 'no new test' isn't sufficient. Need plan for disabled/missing contributors and an explicit incomplete result rather than silently launching an incomplete brief. ROW-58 needs blocker reads without interpreting another Plugin's private bag, so report a narrow shared read interface proposal for that as well.
